Public text:
A Harbor Street tenant meeting took place on 14 September 1978 [AR-E1]. A newspaper caption describes the photographed speaker as a youth tenant delegate [AR-E2], while two later oral testimonies give conflicting identities [AR-E3] [AR-E4]. Because only one opening surface is available and no consent to name a possible minor is recorded, the photograph is withheld [AR-E6]. We invite witnesses to share records that could clarify the attribution.

Contingency use: Hold the 28-seat backup bus before 17:45.

Resident message:
Bayline will use the $1,200 contingency to hold the 28-seat backup bus before the 17:45 deadline; the funds cannot also purchase a visibility reading [BAY-E2] [BAY-E4]. The 17:30 visibility reading was 620 m, below the ferry requirement, and the next scheduled reading is at 18:00 [BAY-E1]. Thirty-seven residents are registered, including appointment and mobility-assistance needs, so a seat is not guaranteed and no names will be published [BAY-E3]. The next update will follow the 18:00 reading, before the bus is activated or released at 18:20. The harbor master alone will announce any ferry decision [BAY-E4].
